# Phaseline

> We build websites, business systems and custom software for manufacturers, exporters, traders and service businesses across India.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.phaseline.in/): Phaseline builds websites, business systems and custom software for manufacturers, exporters, traders and service businesses across India.
- [Work](https://www.phaseline.in/work): Selected websites and business systems Phaseline has built for manufacturers, traders and service businesses across India.
- [Services](https://www.phaseline.in/services): Custom websites, admin and operations systems, and bespoke software with an AI assistant add-on. 3 to 8 weeks, you own it, 6 months support included.
- [Process](https://www.phaseline.in/process): How Phaseline takes a website, business system or custom software from first call to launch, in 3 to 8 weeks depending on scope.
- [About](https://www.phaseline.in/about): Phaseline is a studio in Delhi building websites, business systems and custom software for Indian B2B businesses. Design, build and support in-house.
- [Contact](https://www.phaseline.in/contact): Tell us what you need. Start a website, business system or software project with Phaseline, a studio based in Delhi. Chat on WhatsApp or send an enquiry.

## Policies

- [Privacy Policy](https://www.phaseline.in/privacy): How Phaseline collects, uses and protects the personal information you share through this website, and the choices you have.
- [Terms & Conditions](https://www.phaseline.in/terms): The terms that apply when you use the Phaseline website and our services: scope, timelines, payment, ownership, support and limits.
- [Cookies Policy](https://www.phaseline.in/cookies): What Phaseline stores in your browser. This website sets no cookies of its own and uses no analytics or advertising trackers.
- [Cancellation & Refunds](https://www.phaseline.in/cancellation-and-refunds): How to cancel a Phaseline project or the Care plan, what happens to the work if you cancel, and how refunds are handled.
